import Dict exposing (Dict)
import Set exposing (Set)

pub type Choice = Empty | Filled Int
pub opaque type Box = Box Int

pub record : Int → { count : Int, label : String }
record n = { count = n, label = "x" }

pub tuple : Int → Int × String
tuple n = ( n, "x" )

pub choice : Int → Choice
choice n = Filled n

pub empty : Choice
empty = Empty

pub box : Int → Box
box n = Box n

pub array : Int → List Int
array n = [ n, n + 1, n + 2 ]

pub view : List Int → List Int
view xs =
    case xs of
        [ _, …rest ] → rest
        [] → []

pub dict : Int → Dict String Int
dict n = Dict.singleton "x" n

pub set : Int → Set Int
set n = Set.singleton n

pub nothing : Maybe Int
nothing = Nothing

pub just : Int → Maybe Int
just n = Just n
